name: Bare the Soul
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target 1 living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You compel the target of the spell to reveal the truth. They must answer truthfully any question asked of them, and cannot refuse to answer. Although they must answer questions, they are not required to provide additional information above and beyond the limits of the question(s). Extremely broad questions can be answered vaguely. You may ask 1 question/round.
